capabilities: record the scroll position of each Markdown file, in Reading view and while editing
restore the saved position when a file is reopened
hide the note while the position is applied, then fade it in
suppress editor focus so restoring does not cause a second jump
clean up records when files are renamed or deleted
extras: Cannot be enabled at the same time as the original simply-scroll plugin; only Markdown views are handled (not PDF or Canvas), positions within roughly the first 10 lines are not remembered, and the cloaking makes opening a file about 40 ms slower.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of Simply Scroll by HornatX, which is no longer maintained.
motivation: The original Simply Scroll by HornatX is no longer maintained, so the author forked it under a new plugin id to keep it working and maintained.
problem: Obsidian opens files at the top again, with a visible jump, because it does not remember how far you scrolled in a file between visits.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of Simply Scroll by HornatX, which is no longer maintained.

summary: Fork of Simply Scroll that remembers each Markdown file's scroll position and silently restores it when the file is reopened, without flicker or jumping.
